function GN({ api: e, install: t, publish: n, path: a = "/api/admin/base-map/atlas", decode: o = (i) => createImageBitmap(i) }) {
  let i = null, s = "spring", r = null, l = 0, c = null;
  async function d() {
    if (!i) return;
    const u = i.editorAssets?.seasonAtlases?.[s];
    if (!u || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(u.sha256) || !Number.isSafeInteger(u.byteLength) || u.byteLength < 1 || u.byteLength > 4 * 1024 * 1024) {
      n({ atlasError: "圖集描述無效", atlasLoading: !1 });
      return;
    }
    const f = s + ":" + u.sha256;
    if (r === f) return;
    r = f;
    const m = ++l, v = s;
    t(null), c?.close(), c = null, n({ atlasLoading: !0, atlasError: "", season: s });
    try {
      const g = await e(a + "?season=" + v, void 0, { binary: !0, maxBytes: u.byteLength, feedback: "local" });
      if (m !== l) return;
      if (g.bytes.length !== u.byteLength || g.sha256 !== u.sha256) throw new Error("圖集長度或摘要不符");
      const h = Array.from(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", g.bytes)), (y) => y.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
      if (m !== l) return;
      if (h !== u.sha256) throw new Error("圖集內容校驗失敗");
      const p = await o(new Blob([g.bytes], { type: "image/png" }));
      if (m !== l) {
        p.close();
        return;
      }
      if (p.width !== 256 || p.height !== 256)
        throw p.close(), new Error("圖集尺寸無效");
      c = p, t(c);
    } catch (g) {
      m === l && (r = null, n({ atlasError: g.message }));
    } finally {
      m === l && n({ atlasLoading: !1 });
    }
  }
  return Object.freeze({
    setSource(u) {
      if (i = u, i) return d();
      l++, r = null, t(null), c?.close(), c = null, n({ atlasLoading: !1, atlasError: "", season: s });
    },
    setSeason(u) {
      if (!["spring", "summer", "autumn", "winter"].includes(u)) throw new Error("季節無效");
      return s = u, d();
    },
    retry: d
  });
}

        return h({ version: l.version, digest: A.snapshot.digest, cities: A.snapshot.cities ?? A.snapshot.template?.content?.cities, updatedAt: A.snapshot.updatedAt }, l.blessed), r = !1, f(), "已保存系統基礎據點並重讀。";
    });
  }
  async function w(I) {
    if (o() || !c() || !l.loaded) throw new Error("請先載入系統基礎據點。");
    const S = d();
    return t(async () => {
      if (await e("/api/admin/base-cities", { cities: { create: I } }), !u(S)) return;
      const k = await e("/api/admin/base-cities");
      if (u(S))
        return h(k.snapshot, k.blessed), r = !1, f(), "已新增基礎據點並重讀。";
    }, { feedback: "local", ownStatus: !0 });
  }
  async function C(I, S) {
    if (o() || !c() || !I) throw new Error("請先選擇要作為來源的遊戲。");
    if (!await a(`確定將遊戲「${S || I}」的全部城池據點覆蓋為系統基礎據點嗎？這會取代現有 ${l.cities.length} 座系統定義。`)) return !1;
    const k = d();
    return t(async () => {
      const N = await e("/api/admin/base-cities/promote", { gameId: I });
      if (!u(k)) return !1;
      const T = N.snapshot, H = T.cities ?? T.template?.content?.cities ?? {}, A = Object.values(H).map((_) => ({ ..._ })).sort((_, J) => (_.runtimeSlot ?? 0) - (J.runtimeSlot ?? 0));
      return Object.assign(l, { loaded: !0, version: T.version, digest: T.digest, updatedAt: T.updatedAt ?? "", cities: A, blessed: N.blessed ?? null, message: "" }), r = !1, f(), `已從遊戲匯入 ${A.length} 座據點為系統基礎。`;
    });
  }
  return f(), Object.freeze({
    setIdentity: m,
    canLeave: v,
    setEditing: g,
    render: f,
    actions: Object.freeze({ enter: () => p(), load: p, reload: y, saveCity: R, createCity: w, promote: C, setEditing: g })
  });
}
function ZN({ api: e, work: t, publish: n, confirm: a, gameContext: o, createWorkbench: i = YN }) {
  let s = null, r = null, l = null, c = null, d = !1, u = null, f = null;
  const m = () => !!(s && !s.user.mustChangePassword && ["admin", "author"].includes(s.user.role));
  function v(h) {
    h === l && c || (c?.dispose(), c = null, l = h, d = !1, n({
      gameScoped: !0,
      gameId: h,
      loaded: !1,
      exists: !1,
      version: "",
      locked: !0,
      dirty: !1,
      readRevision: 0,
      selected: null,
      layers: [],
      materials: [],
      waters: [],
      groups: [],
      diagnostics: [],
      serverProblems: [],
      message: h ? "" : "請先在頂部選擇自己的遊戲。"
    }), !(!h || !m()) && (c = i({ api: e, work: t, publish: n, confirm: a, gameId: h }), c.setIdentity(s), c.actions.attach(u, f)));
  }
  const g = Object.fromEntries(["reload", "initialize", "stage", "undo", "save", "formDirty", "resize", "pick", "pan", "zoom", "fit", "grid", "locate", "focusDiagnostic", "selectGroup", "layer", "previewMaterial", "previewPlacement", "cancelPlacement", "commitPlacement", "beginObjectMove", "previewObjectMove", "commitObjectMove", "cancelObjectMove", "toggleMulti", "beginMultiMove", "groupSelection", "ungroupSelection", "retryAtlas", "command"].map((h) => [h, (...p) => c?.actions[h](...p)]));
  return g.attach = (h, p) => {
    u = h, f = p, c?.actions.attach(u, f);
  }, g.enter = () => {
    if (!(d || !c))
      return d = !0, c.actions.enter();
  }, Object.freeze({
    actions: Object.freeze(g),
    adoptGame: v,
    canAdoptGame: () => m(),
    selectedGame: () => m() ? l : null,
    canLeave: (h) => c?.canLeave(h) ?? !0,
    dirty: () => c?.dirty() ?? !1,
    render: () => c?.render(),
    setIdentity(h) {
      if (s === h && r === (h?.version ?? null)) {
        c?.setIdentity(h);
        return;
      }
      c?.dispose(), c = null, l = null, s = h, r = h?.version ?? null, v(m() ? o.current() : null), c?.setIdentity(h);
    },
    dispose() {
      c?.dispose(), c = null, u = null, f = null;
    }
  });
}
